findings: Non-blocking: live end-to-end smoke (make up + curl) was not executed because Docker was down in the build environment; the no-agents guarantee is instead proven by an in-process integration test. Run the live smoke before the leadership demo.

Non-blocking: the public /v1/checkout response hardwires verdicts: {} and surfaces route_alternatives at top level rather than nested under verdicts.routing as docs/06 §1 depicts; this is a deliberate Phase-2 no-agents shaping to revisit when agents land.
Non-blocking: async mode does not persist the idempotency record, so a repeated idempotency_key in async mode re-mints a transaction rather than replaying; harmless in the sync-default demo flow.
Nit: checkout-api and commerce-orchestrator depend on downstreams with condition: service_started rather than service_healthy, so make up may surface transient 5xx until readyz passes.
